unlock.first_20_boundary: Shows that filling a blank berth field creates receiver custody but not automatically freedom.

metadata.truth_payload: A receiver counterstamp with a room number breaks the blank berth state, but the room owner and custody class decide whether recovery becomes protection, quarantine hold or corporate capture.
metadata.player_question: Which room number matters: the one that saves the body, or the one that owns it?

en_US.title: Receiver Counterstamp Room Number
en_US.scanner: COUNTERSTAMP READ // Quarantine room number present. Verify body custody class; sample-only rooms do not clear living recovery.
en_US.terminal: RECEIVER ROOM COUNTERSEAL // Blank berth overwritten by owned custody. Lift allocation may proceed only under named room, owner and body class.
en_US.audio: Room number written. Receiver owns the door. Confirm body custody before ascent burn.
en_US.in_game_wiki: A receiver counterstamp is the moment a blank berth becomes a named door. It can make recovery harder to ignore, but it also names who owns the body after lift. Check the room class, medical owner and receiver strip before trusting the stamp.
en_US.external_site: A longform receiver-room primer on the counterstamp that turns a blank quarantine berth into owned custody without making that custody safe.
en_US.field_note: A room number is a handle. Pull it carefully; some doors are cages.

ru_RU.title: Номер комнаты receiver counterstamp
ru_RU.scanner: ЧТЕНИЕ COUNTERSTAMP // Quarantine room number присутствует. Проверь body custody class; sample-only rooms не очищают living recovery.
ru_RU.terminal: RECEIVER ROOM COUNTERSEAL // Blank berth перезаписан owned custody. Lift allocation возможен только при named room, owner и body class.
ru_RU.audio: Room number записан. Receiver владеет дверью. Подтверди body custody до ascent burn.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Receiver counterstamp это момент, когда blank berth становится named door. Он может сделать recovery труднее игнорировать, но он также называет того, кто владеет телом после lift. Проверь room class, medical owner и receiver strip, прежде чем доверять stamp.
ru_RU.external_site: Большой primer о receiver room и counterstamp, который превращает пустой quarantine berth в owned custody, не делая эту custody безопасной.
ru_RU.field_note: Room number это ручка. Тяни осторожно: некоторые двери являются клетками.

de_DE.title: Raumnummer des Receiver-Counterstamps

de_DE.audio: Room number geschrieben. Receiver besitzt die Tür. Body custody vor ascent burn bestätigen.
de_DE.in_game_wiki: Ein receiver counterstamp ist der Moment, in dem ein blank berth zu einer named door wird. Er kann recovery schwerer ignorierbar machen, benennt aber auch, wer den Körper nach dem lift besitzt. Prüfe room class, medical owner und receiver strip, bevor du dem stamp vertraust.
de_DE.external_site: Ein Longform-Primer über receiver room und den counterstamp, der einen leeren quarantine berth in owned custody verwandelt, ohne diese custody sicher zu machen.
de_DE.field_note: Eine room number ist ein Griff. Zieh vorsichtig; manche Türen sind Käfige.
